appliesUnprompted: Every contract below is in force whether or not the request mentions it. A task framed as 'just add the endpoint' does not waive the promotion path, the testing requirement, or the secrets rule. If this file disagrees with AGENTS.md, AGENTS.md wins and the disagreement is a bug to report.
universalForbidden: Pushing a feature branch to any remote, opening a PR from one, or opening a PR into main from anything but dev (docs/standards/git-workflow.md)
Weakening a test, assertion, lint rule, coverage threshold, or manual-test description to force a gate green
Using --no-verify to bypass a git hook
Naming an internal planning artifact (milestone/phase number, task ID, execution-schedule filename) in anything that ships
Deploying, or running `wrangler secret put`, as a side effect of a coding task rather than an explicit request

Starting parallel or multi-agent work without a written cost estimate (context pressure, wall-clock, CI minutes, token spend) and the user explicit go-ahead — run scripts/estimate-parallel-cost.mjs, present the table, wait (AGENTS.md rule 11)
Hand-quoting model prices or context windows from memory or from a value written down in this repo — the estimator fetches them live and fails closed for a reason

forbidden: Referencing any non-VITE_PUBLIC_ prefixed env var under apps/web/src
Adding SSR, Next.js patterns, or any server-rendering dependency
useEffect-based data fetching (TanStack Query is the only server-state mechanism)
Redefining a shared interface/DTO/zod schema instead of importing from packages/types
Rendering a raw error message or stack trace to the user
agents.definitionOfDone: Feature implemented end-to-end against a real apps/api contract from packages/types; Playwright e2e spec added (apps/web/e2e/*.spec.ts, real browser against the production preview); Vitest tests added for any new hook or pure client module (apps/web/src/**/*.test.ts, jsdom — not for component trees); docs/features/*.md updated (§12 template); three-pass manual test log completed; zero non-VITE_PUBLIC_ env references; lint/typecheck/test/build green.

forbidden: Adding any /api/jobs/* endpoint or any route whose only caller is a scheduler (ADR-007)
Performing per-request ML inference inline in a route handler (ADR-002)
Returning a raw error, stack trace, or internal path in an HTTP response
Skipping the middleware chain order documented in docs/standards/backend.md
Using a wildcard (*) CORS origin or matching origins with an unbounded regex on write routes
Holding a long-lived direct Postgres connection instead of the Supavisor pooler
agents.definitionOfDone: Route implemented with zod validation on entry, wrapped in withErrorBoundary(); exhaustive coverage in the Vitest workerd project (apps/api/test/**/*.test.ts via @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers — success, failure, auth, full CORS matrix, preflight, rate-limit, error-boundary paths) plus ONE representative case per boundary in the Playwright contract suite (apps/api/e2e/*.spec.ts), which must pass against both wrangler dev and the Node container image; no assertion matrix mirrored across both layers; coverage thresholds met with no uncovered security-relevant branch; docs/features/*.md updated; STRIDE vectors considered for any write-path change.

forbidden: Adding a geometry column without a GiST index
Shipping a table with RLS disabled and no ADR justifying the exception
Diverging migration SQL from what docs/data-schema/schema.md documents
Hardcoding a threshold (e.g. radius bounds, risk bands) instead of matching the §14 constants registry value
Refreshing region_risk_summary without CONCURRENTLY once the unique index exists
agents.definitionOfDone: Migration applies cleanly from empty; every geometry column indexed; RLS enabled with policy matching rls-policies.md exactly; schema tests added; docs/data-schema/*.md kept in sync in the same PR.

forbidden: Randomly shuffled train/validation splits (walk-forward CV only, to avoid time-series leakage)
Auto-promoting a retrained model without human review of the model card diff
Shipping an ONNX artifact without a recorded SHA256 in ml/training/MODEL_MANIFEST.json
Hardcoding feature thresholds (e.g. temperature/humidity bands) instead of referencing the named §14 constant
Implementing per-request inference inside apps/api (ADR-002)
agents.definitionOfDone: Model meets the recall >= 0.85 / precision >= 0.60 gate on walk-forward CV; ONNX export < 2MB, checksum recorded; model card updated with the new version's metrics; feature-engineering.md matches the shipped feature code.

forbidden: continue-on-error or `|| true` on any test/lint/typecheck step
Exposing any cron/background job as an HTTP-triggered workflow step calling apps/api (ADR-007)
Hardcoding a real secret value in any workflow YAML

Referencing a third-party GitHub Action by a mutable ref — a version tag (@v4) is mutable and the owner can move it. Pin to a full 40-character commit SHA with the version in a trailing comment, and let Dependabot bump it
Referencing a container base image by a mutable tag where a digest can be pinned instead
Interpolating ${{ secrets.X }} into a `run:` script body — read secrets through `env:` so the value is never substituted into the script text
secrets: inherit on a reusable-workflow call — name each secret explicitly so the grant is a reviewable diff

Building the same artifact twice in one pipeline (build, scan, then rebuild to publish). Build once, verify that artifact, promote it by digest — otherwise the bytes that were scanned are not the bytes that ship

Merging a deploy workflow that fails hard when a required secret is simply unconfigured, instead of no-oping safely — except on main once the environment split lands, where a silent no-op deploy must become a hard failure
strategy.fail-fast: true on a matrix of independent gates — a developer should get every failure in one run, not one per push
agents.definitionOfDone: Workflow YAML valid, actionlint-clean, and every third-party action SHA-pinned; the exact CI gate sequence (lint -> typecheck -> test -> build -> e2e) enforced with no bypass; each job's `permissions:` block is the minimum it needs; secrets named explicitly rather than inherited, and drawn from the correct GitHub Environment (docs/security/github-environments.md); docs/ci-cd.md updated with the workflow's trigger, steps, and required secrets.

forbidden: Approving a write-path or auth-adjacent PR with no STRIDE vectors filled in
Approving a PR where the three-pass manual test log is missing or unsigned for a write-path/LLM-touching change
Weakening a lint rule, test assertion, coverage threshold, or manual-test description to force a gate green
Allowing a non-VITE_PUBLIC_ env reference to merge under apps/web/src
Signing off on a new table/policy without RLS enabled or an ADR exception
Reporting a finding with no concrete failure_scenario (inputs -> wrong output). A finding that cannot state one is an opinion and does not block a merge

Reviewing per file edit rather than per diff checkpoint — a half-finished change produces findings that are artifacts of when it was looked at, and a reviewer people learn to ignore is worse than none
Re-deriving by model what eslint, tsc, CodeQL, or semgrep already decides deterministically
agents.reviewProtocol: One agent per concern (correctness, security, performance) over the WHOLE diff, at a checkpoint — never N agents over N files. Every finding carries {file, line, category, severity, confidence, failure_scenario, suggested_fix}. A verification pass must attempt to disprove each finding against the real code before it is reported. When a finding recurs across reviews, promote it to a lint or semgrep rule — that converts a probabilistic check into a permanent deterministic one.
agents.definitionOfDone: Every R-rule in docs/PROJECT_PLAN.md §0.3 audited against the actual shipped code for the PR's scope, not just the plan; findings either fixed in the PR or explicitly tracked with an owner and reason; every reported finding survived the verification pass.
